question: Why should one examine words according to meaning everywhere here?
premises: One should examine words according to meaning everywhere.
It was said in auspicious night practice.
The name here is considered threefold.
inference: The verse justifies examining words by meaning through a threefold naming.
plain_english: Here one should examine words according to meaning everywhere, because it was said in auspicious night practice; the name here is considered threefold.
